item.title: What Makes You Mediocre
item.description: 1. Lacking a Desire That Comes from Within Desire is what creates motivation. The desire to survive and the desire for something better are the wellspring that drives human progress. The stronger the desire, the stronger the motivation. An intense desire makes a person charge at the goal regardless of everything.

item.title: Keep Running
item.description: 1. On Running When you talk about running, it is easy to think of Haruki Murakami’s What I Talk About When I Talk About Running. The sentence pattern “What I talk about when I talk about XX” has been widely quoted, which says something about the influence of the book.

item.title: How to Configure an HHKB Keyboard
item.description: 1. About Keyboard Types There are mainly three types of keyboards: Mechanical keyboard Every key on a mechanical keyboard has its own separate switch, also called a “switch” (axis). Classified by the micro switch type, mechanical keyboards are divided into brown, blue, white, black, and red switches. Mechanical keyboards feel comfortable to type on, but they are on the expensive side.

item.title: The Story of the Unicorn
item.description: Long, long ago, there was a unicorn forest with many, many great trees. In the forest lived a mother unicorn and a little unicorn, along with lots and lots of small animals. The mother unicorn had a very beautiful horn growing on her head, and it looked lovely there. Her horn was magical: when a little rabbit got hurt, the mother unicorn touched it with her horn, and the sparkles that fell from the horn landed on the rabbit’s wound, and the rabbit’s injury healed right away.
